benchmark_note: All questions are source-derived and synthetic. Appended gold cues are removed before retrieval. Aircraft model is treated as a visible scope field because it is stated in the query. Locked track, query_type, required slots, gold/accepted IDs, pages and sections are excluded from ranking and package selection and are used only after retrieval for audit.
interpretation_boundary: The short/long distinction is a state-lifetime and document-structure hierarchy: detail/page are query-local working evidence; section/component profiles are persistent repository memory. It is not a natural maintenance-event timeline or a deployed conversational memory backend. Entropy is a retrieval-concentration proxy, not safety confidence or mutual information.
